hero.badge: Phase 13: Landing, SEO, docs, and growth
hero.title: The premium WhatsApp AI workspace for teams that need automation without chaos.
hero.description: Wabrix combines compliant WhatsApp delivery, AI-assisted replies, human handoff, billing control, and analytics in one product that is actually built for operations, not demos.
hero.snapshotTitle: The stack is already past toy mode.
hero.snapshotDescription: Behind the landing page, the repo already includes Convex tenancy, Clerk auth, staging-safe ingress, outbound queueing, template flow, billing, and analytics.

0.label: Inbound pipeline
0.body: Meta signatures, raw event durability, normalization, contacts, conversations, and service-window tracking already exist.

1.label: Reply orchestration
1.body: Bot pause, handoff, opt-out, template fallback, and send-time policy rechecks are already enforced in backend flows.

2.label: Monetization
2.body: Indonesia routes to Midtrans with IDR while global traffic routes to Polar with USD and provider-agnostic subscription state.

hero.snapshotFootnote: This phase makes the product presentable to prospects without breaking the operational contracts that earlier phases already established.

features.title: One product for the whole WhatsApp operating loop.
features.description: Instead of stitching five tools together, Wabrix keeps delivery, policy checks, automation, human takeover, and billing state close enough to stay reliable.

0.title: Verified ingress
0.body: Cloudflare Worker ingress validates Meta signatures, handles challenge verification, and stores raw events durably before returning 200.

1.title: Policy-aware sending
1.body: The product rechecks the 24-hour window, opt-out state, and queue safety before outbound send, not just in the UI.

2.title: Operator inbox
2.body: Assignment, notes, translation, handoff, and manual reply all live next to the thread instead of scattered across admin screens.

3.title: AI that stays scoped
3.body: Bot Studio, knowledge retrieval, prompt versions, and runtime logs are tenant-scoped so one org cannot bleed into another.

4.title: Templates and media
4.body: Approved templates, media transcript enrichment, and WhatsApp lifecycle visibility are already part of the same product surface.

5.title: Billing that matches geography
5.body: Global checkout can stay USD through Polar while Indonesian buyers get a native IDR path through Midtrans.

workflow.title: From webhook to reply queue with fewer blind spots.
workflow.description: The operational story is simple: ingest safely, map identity correctly, draft only when allowed, and send with audit-friendly state.

0.title: 1. Capture
0.body: Ingress receives WhatsApp events, validates signatures, deduplicates, and writes the raw payload durably into Convex.

1.title: 2. Normalize
1.body: Inbound processing maps contacts, conversations, messages, and service-window state so the transcript becomes usable by both bot and operator.

2.title: 3. Orchestrate
2.body: The bot drafts when policy allows, queues replies durably, and later reconciles delivery state from Meta status webhooks.

proof.title: Not a pretty shell hiding a missing backend.
proof.description: Phase 13 ships on top of real runtime behavior that has already passed manual DoD in staging.

0.title: Real staging path
0.body: Convex, Clerk, Cloudflare Worker, and Vercel already run in isolated staging with real webhook traffic.

1.title: Operational docs included
1.body: Public docs now explain setup, lifecycle, template approval, and service-window rules so new operators onboard faster.

2.title: Growth without pretending
2.body: The public pages are allowed to sell, but they stay anchored to what the product genuinely does today.

testimonials.title: Built for operators, not just founders showing a deck.

faq.title: Questions smart buyers and operators ask early.
faq.description: Short answers only. The public docs go deeper where operational detail matters.

0.question: Does this already support real WhatsApp traffic?
0.answer: Yes. Staging already validates Meta signatures, stores raw webhook events, normalizes inbound messages, drafts replies, and reconciles delivery status.

1.question: How do billing and pricing differ by market?
1.answer: Indonesia is routed to Midtrans with IDR while non-Indonesian traffic defaults to Polar with USD. The pricing page surfaces that logic directly.

2.question: Can operators take over from the bot?
2.answer: Yes. Inbox already supports assignment, internal notes, manual reply, bot pause, and handoff controls.

3.question: Where do I learn the policy rules fast?
3.answer: Start with the public docs for WhatsApp setup, WABA lifecycle, template approval, and service-window rules.

seo.title: Pricing | Wabrix
seo.description: Explore Wabrix pricing with region-aware checkout logic: Midtrans in IDR for Indonesia and Polar in USD for global traffic.

Pricing.headline: Premium pricing that still respects how your buyers actually pay.
Pricing.subheadline: The plan catalog stays consistent, but checkout routing changes by market. Indonesia uses Midtrans in IDR. Global traffic defaults to Polar in USD. No weird split-brain pricing story.
Pricing.indiaNotSupportedHint: If your team sells in both Indonesia and global markets, keep the same plan logic and let the checkout provider switch by geography instead of forking your product story.
Pricing.regionIndonesiaBody: Use this view when the buyer should pay locally in IDR through Midtrans. It matches the phase-12 checkout behavior already implemented in the app.
Pricing.regionGlobalBody: Use this view for non-Indonesia traffic. Polar keeps the pricing story in USD and fits the global purchase flow.
Pricing.trustedBody: Geo-aware routing uses Cloudflare or Vercel country headers when available, while the page keeps a clear region preview so sales and ops can validate the path before checkout.
Pricing.compareTitle: One pricing story, two checkout rails.
Pricing.compareBody: This page is intentionally tied to the real billing logic already running in the product instead of pretending pricing is universal everywhere.
